change: Replace the 76 KB paginated model-facing capability catalog with a deterministic 53-row, 24.5 KB index preserving every available/unavailable package, exact version, supported export, limitation, implementation, and evidence field.

strengths: AsyncStorage, multiple same-day records, all four destinations, full primary actions, per-unit weekly comparisons, immediate weekly notes, inline SVG chart/icons, and animated confetti are implemented.
The repair adds a shared exportBackup action used directly by both the 20-record banner and Profile; expo-sharing and clipboard fallback use exact catalog versions.
The desktop screenshot has compact fixed navigation, legible hierarchy, coherent cold-white/purple/status colors, and no starter residue or error overlay.
Typecheck, source audit, Harmony Go export, artifact binding, exact desktop install/open, and trace isolation pass.
gaps: Forecast starts with a single recent entry instead of requiring enough real sample days.
Streak and yellow/red missed-day scans do not stop at goal.createdAt.
Legacy migration supports only the current goals/entries shape; shareAsync still uses an unproven data URI instead of a local file URI.
Clear-samples has no confirmation and clear-all relies only on the exact phrase rather than a second dialog.
Seed has 18 records, so the >=20 backup banner is not initially visible and the seed does not visibly cover both yellow-rest and red-rollover examples.
Board and weekly notes use desktop multi-column layouts, but the primary Today list remains one column in the desktop launch screenshot.
Core mutation/restart persistence was intentionally not executed in this loop, so runtime persistence remains unproven for this artifact.
